title: [DE] Data transfer center
subtitle: [DE] Download a template, upload your completed file, map the columns and run the import.

rules.title: [DE] Template rules
rules.headers: [DE] Do not change the headers; if you do, map those columns manually in the column mapping step.
rules.deleteColumns: [DE] You can delete columns you don't need; data in deleted columns is left unchanged.
rules.dates: [DE] Write dates as DD.MM.YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 01.06.2026); textual dates are not accepted.
rules.lookups: [DE] Option values as well as unit and manager values must already exist in the system.
rules.matching: [DE] Employees are matched by National ID + First name + Last name.

options.title: [DE] Options

updateOnlyHelp.noMatchError: [DE] Rows that don't match an existing record are reported as errors.
updateOnlyHelp.mappedOnly: [DE] Only mapped columns are written; empty cells leave existing data unchanged.

options.updateOnlyUnsupported: [DE] This template does not support update only mode.

failurePolicy.SkipInvalidRowsHelp: [DE] Valid rows are imported; invalid rows are reported in the result file.
failurePolicy.AllOrNothingHelp: [DE] If any row is invalid, nothing is imported.

errorCodes.IMPORT_NO_MATCH: [DE] No matching record found (update only mode does not create new records).
errorCodes.IMPORT_NAME_MISMATCH: [DE] The national ID matched, but the first or last name differs from the existing record.
errorCodes.IMPORT_DUPLICATE_ROW: [DE] The same national ID appears in more than one row of the file.
errorCodes.IMPORT_INVALID_DATE: [DE] Invalid date; use DD.MM.YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY.
errorCodes.IMPORT_LOOKUP_NOT_FOUND: [DE] The value is not defined in the system; create the related record first.
